vector_addition.review_basis: Root and independent reviewer read the six source modules and shared integer conversion semantics. All18 observed original TTIR store graphs preserve operand order, source-width signed/unsigned conversion and exact destination type. The software backend directly rounds exact integers once to fp32, uses concrete FP.add cfg, and converts with shared toward-zero finite/range semantics. The .real carrier is scoped to explicit fp32 and identity-retagged; it is not native fp64. Full ascending execution threads previous memory and equals an independent initial-memory formula with a complete frame, including equal logical region names. Total execution exposes arbitrary undefined signed/unsigned conversion policies. The second theorem restricts only active integer-output conversions to their defined domain, proving the output independent of those policies. fp32-output orientation has no finiteness/domain premise; masked lanes are unconstrained. Bool output3 remains i8 3, while128 retains the undefined policy. Native poison/trap/sanitizer, source/compiler, bytes/tags, addresses and scheduling remain structural gaps.

relu_triton_kernel.dtype_profile: Nine finite-input-word profiles: signed/unsigned8/16/32/64 and all256 raw bool bytes. InputWords binds tagged logical cells below N; full ascending pid-zero-only grid, fp32 output and arbitrary prelaunch tail. No new logical dtype names.
unclosed_numeric_callbacks: M.fromInt none on decoded signed source-width integers
M.fromNat none on decoded unsigned words or normalized unsigned i1 bool
M.literal none fp32 0 in the signed negative branch
relu_triton_kernel.review_basis: Root read all three new sources and independently traced all nine original integer/bool TTIR store graphs. BitVec8/16/32/64 decoding has bounds and source-word roundtrips; all256 raw bool bytes normalize by nonzero to unsigned i1. Small inputs extend only for comparison; source-width integer conversion feeds fp32 select. InputWords constrains the entire tagged Cell at every active input offset. Actual typed-grid success is constructed from this structural input relation and equals an independent initial-word formula. Only pid0 writes, every write has fp32 tag, and the arbitrary prelaunch tail/frame is retained. Equal logical region names are allowed; y!=x is only needed for a separate constructor lemma preserving a supplied output initialization. Nine finite-word profiles refine existing logical profiles without adding dtype names. Floating conversion/zero callbacks and all native memory/compiler/address/host gaps remain explicit.
